BT25-085#effect#4.label: DUAL Effect
BT25-085#effect#4.reason: <Use Req.> of the Option face: card-data gap, measured (NOTES-BT25-085.md): data/cards.json carries BT25-085 as card_kind 0 (Digimon) with no `dual` block, and the engine takes CardKind from that file, so the production/harness engine never sees the Option face. `play: {card: BT25-085, from: hand}` lowers as a 6-cost Digimon play the printed face forbids, while DCGO (IsDualCard) uses an Option -- no line is legal on both sides. Unreachable until cards.json gets card_kind 4 + a dual block (same gap: BT25-043, BT25-057, BT25-104, ST23-09).
